setup_rag_args: add RAG model, retriever, and indexer CLI arguments to a ParlaiParser instance
use_retrievertype_enum: use the RetrieverType enum to select DPR, TFIDF, or poly-encoder retriever types
configure_zoo_model_paths: reference DPR, TFIDF, RAG, and FID zoo model path constants for model loading
configure_transformer_ranker_options: use TRANSFORMER_RANKER_BASE_OPT dictionary to set default transformer ranker hyperparameters
configure_polyencoder_options: use POLYENCODER_OPT_KEYS list to identify poly-encoder configuration option names
